prompts.factory: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ENTIRE GAME LEVEL background, not sprite sheet, not parts kit. Create one wide 2:1 rectangular complete industrial factory room for a Brazilian post-apocalyptic 16bit overhead action game. Camera orthographic elevated 3/4, all vertical walls straight screen-vertical, no isometric diagonals, no perspective vanishing point. Think a real768x384pixel game world, a human sprite is32pixels high. Flat clean native pixel art, bold continuous silhouettes, deliberately LOW detail, sixteen coherent colors, simple flat planes, no gradients, no dithering, no weathering speckles or tiny rivets. Top-left light, short consistent shadows. The entire perimeter and ALL FOUR CORNERS must be drawn and visible in the image, no margins, no labels, no UI, no characters, no insects, no eggs. This is the full room, not a screenshot cropping off the bottom. Upper band90pixels high is a real factory back wall: closed blue industrial loading door at LEFT, one broad central furnace with an orange grill, a pair of cylindrical blue pressure tanks at RIGHT. Large complete walls/door/boiler/tanks, roof edge and foot meet cleanly. Lower foreground band48pixels high is a purpose-drawn LOW interior brick/plated wall with a continuous cap, visible inside face, large connected horizontal service pipe and intact corners joining the side walls. NO doors or rolling shutters on this LOWER wall. Left and right side boundaries16pixels wide connect upper wall to lower wall with COMPLETE rounded inner corners; same scale and palette. Middle floor is calm desaturated warm gray concrete with very widely spaced subtle joints, free combat space at least600x200pixels. At middle floor y185there are THREE compact complete pressure stations, evenly separated across the room: each one has a short broad steel cabinet behind a waist-high RED handwheel on BLUE piping; each cabinet must have a whole base with a small contact shadow. Each wheel is clearly below its cabinet, never lying on another machine, never covering a conveyor. The blue supply pipes run from back wall to station through continuous narrow FLOOR conduits, drawn as low walkable pipes, with real elbow joints, not reused wall scraps. ONE complete modest roller conveyor96x32pixels stands near lower-left-middle of floor(y260), leaving wide paths around every side; whole four legs, two end caps, no repeated severed parts. ONE complete pallet of sealed brown crates48x40near lower-right-middle(y260). Stations do not touch these obstacles. Keep ten clear floor locations around these objects for later egg sprites, but DO NOT paint egg shapes, circles, letters, markers, pads or symbols there. A coherent complete factory, four regions(upper architecture, lower boundary, side boundaries, field objects). Clear readable architectural mass in north AND south camera views. Avoid clutter, pure empty black gaps, cut columns, cropped neighbors, floating machine fragments, excessive repeating identical boilers. No text.
prompts.street: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ENTIRE LONG GAME LEVEL environmental panorama, not sprite sheet, no grid labels. One complete 3:1 wide industrial street corridor for a Brazilian post-apocalyptic16bit overhead action game. Camera elevated orthographic3/4, flatfront building facades, allverticals screenvertical and road horizontal, NO isometric diagonals or vanishing perspective. The concept represents a long level2560pixels long with a32pixel human sprite, palette16colors. Clean LOW DETAIL native pixel art with flat planes and bold shapes, no gradient, no dithering, no tiny rivets, no photograph weathering, no fine clutter. Light top-left with restrained short ground shadows. Draw the complete street including BOTH ENDS and all four perimeter corners, no margins, UI, labels, characters, monsters. Compose four connected regions: upper band about110pixels high is coherent industrial architecture with THREE distinct deliberately separated sectors: early red-brick workshop with ONE whole blue service door and two broad windows, middle loading warehouse with ONE whole broad roller door and a simple gantry, final factory compound with a pair of large blue tanks and one singular large identifiable CLOSED FACTORY GATE at the far right destination. The other lengths between these landmarks are calm continuous brick or metal walls, not infinite repetitions of small cropped doors. Roof caps, wall bases and bay frames meet continuously. Lower foreground band32pixels high is a purpose-drawn low masonry retaining wall with an unbroken stone cap, simple rails and COMPLETE corners at both corridor ends; no water, no stairs, no clipped pipes. Both side boundaries connect top and bottom, left side has one modest pedestrian entry gap to begin the journey, right side closes around the factory end without black voids. Central street is a calm gray concrete combat corridor at least120pixels wide vertically, with very sparse broad expansion joints and no lane arrow textures. FOUR complete grounded obstacles of VARIED sizes and positions organize a winding route: a closed cargo crate near upper-left third of roadway, a short intact bundle of steel pipes toward lower-middle, one small parked yellow compressor near upper-right-middle with cable fully coiled on machine(no dangling cut tail), and a broad closed blue cargo bin before the final factory approach. Each has intact whole silhouette, support/feet, short shadow and ample room to go above/below; do not align all at same height. Do not add parking stripe halos around objects. Keep objects far from the singular factory gate. Narrative progression workshop→loading warehouse→factory is clear in the WHOLE panorama. Preserve consistent material scale, top-left lighting, designed corners. Avoid stamps, incomplete posts, cropped windows at module edges, machine fragments, excessive dense repeated architecture. No text.
